methods.name: ARIMA(p,d,q) by conditional sum of squares: coefficients, mean, drift, sigma^2, CSS log-likelihood, AIC
methods.reference: forecast::Arima(method = 'CSS'), re-solved to the exact CSS optimum (Gauss-Newton on stats::arima(fixed) residuals, numDeriv::jacobian; for the misspecified seasonal series, where Gauss-Newton does not contract, Newton's method on the analytic gradient of those residuals); stats::arima CSS log-likelihood
quantities: converged, no warning (ARIMA(1,1,1) with drift on a misspecified seasonal series)
methods.tolerance: coefficients Tol::iterative(1e-6) against the exact CSS optimum (iterative; both sides solved to 1e-8 scaled steps), forecast::Arima's own optimum at 1e-3; SSR, sigma2, loglik, AIC Tol::stat(n) (1e-6 for n = 100..1000); residuals abs 1e-7; MCP/CLI text at print precision

methods.tolerance: fixed coefficients: Tol::coef(n), Tol::se(n) (n = 40, 300); after a fit: Tol::stat(300); package optimum's means at 1e-5
